Therefore [tH(b)+4k+2c-q(2k+3c)]/[tI(b)+k] <= H(F)/I(F) <= that lower bound +2cq^2/[3(1-q)(tI(b)+k)]. The exact entropy is q t H(b)+(4q-2q^2)k-2(1-q)^2 log2(1-q); variance is 2q-q^2 and minority probability q/2. If k=o(t) and 2^-k t->0 for a fixed seed, H(F)/I(F)->H(b)/I(b) with influence tending to zero. exact_statement: For every finite uniform-cube Boolean f, every input permutation pi, input sign vector eta, and output sign epsilon, define fprime(x)=epsilon f(eta_1*x_pi(1),...,eta_n*x_pi(n)). The squared Fourier law of fprime at pi(S) equals that of f at S. For every coordinate i, B_pi(i)(fprime)=B_i(f) and Inf_pi(i)(fprime)=Inf_i(f), and physical children correspond under the residual signed permutation with fair branch weights preserved. Therefore min and max of B_i/Inf_i over relevant coordinates are NPN invariant. Constants have no defined relevant-coordinate ratio. This does not certify a complete NPN catalogue, its count, or invariance under arbitrary linear F2 input changes or Fourier character multiplication.
hypotheses: NPN means input permutation, independent input sign negations and one output sign
